serverInfo.name: buy-me-a-coffee-mcp
serverInfo.title: Buy Me a Coffee MCP by usefulapi

result.instructions: Tools for Buy Me a Coffee, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Who are my active members, and how much does each one pay?"; "List my one-time supporters from this month with their notes."; "Which Extras were purchased most recently?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Buy Me a Coffee data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run buymeacoffee_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run buymeacoffee_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run buymeacoffee_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. buymeacoffee_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: buymeacoffee_list_members
tools.title: List members
tools.description: List the creator's recurring members (memberships) with status, price, currency, period dates and payer. API: GET /api/v1/subscriptions. The result holds personal data of supporters (names, emails, messages): use it only for the creator's own work.

status.description: Filter by membership status (default: the vendor default).

tools.name: buymeacoffee_get_member
tools.title: Get a member
tools.description: Get one membership by id, including cancellation state and the current billing period. API: GET /api/v1/subscriptions/{id}. The result holds personal data of supporters (names, emails, messages): use it only for the creator's own work.

tools.name: buymeacoffee_list_supporters
tools.title: List one-time supporters
tools.description: List one-time supporters with coffees, amount, currency, note, country and refund flag. API: GET /api/v1/supporters. The result holds personal data of supporters (names, emails, messages): use it only for the creator's own work.

tools.name: buymeacoffee_get_supporter
tools.title: Get a one-time supporter
tools.description: Get one one-time support (a single payment) by id. API: GET /api/v1/supporters/{id}. The result holds personal data of supporters (names, emails, messages): use it only for the creator's own work.

tools.name: buymeacoffee_list_extras
tools.title: List Extras purchases
tools.description: List purchases of the creator's Extras (rewards, products) with amount, payer and the Extra's title and settings. API: GET /api/v1/extras. The result holds personal data of supporters (names, emails, messages): use it only for the creator's own work.

tools.name: buymeacoffee_get_extra_purchase
tools.title: Get an Extras purchase
tools.description: Get one Extras purchase by id. API: GET /api/v1/extras/{id}. The result holds personal data of supporters (names, emails, messages): use it only for the creator's own work.
